import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] fact = new long[501];
    static long[] invFact = new long[501];
    static long[] fdp = new long[501];
    static long[] gdp = new long[501];
    static long[][][] hdp = new long[501][501][2];
    static long[][] combi = new long[501][501];
    static long total, res, temp;
    static int N, M, MOD, invMOD, a, b, c;

    static long binpow(long base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % MOD;
            base = base * base % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();
        invMOD = MOD - 2;

        fact[0] = 1;
        for (a = 1; a <= N; a++) {
            fact[a] = fact[a - 1] * a % MOD;
        }
        invFact[N] = binpow(fact[N], invMOD);
        for (a = N - 1; a >= 0; a--) {
            invFact[a] = invFact[a + 1] * (a + 1) % MOD;
        }

        combi[0][0] = 1;
        for (a = 1; a <= N; a++) {
            combi[a][0] = 1;
            for (b = 1; b <= a; b++) {
                combi[a][b] = (combi[a - 1][b - 1] + combi[a - 1][b]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        fdp[0] = 1;
        gdp[0] = 0;
        for (a = 1; a <= M; a++) {
            for (b = 1; b <= a; b++) {
                total = (b * (b - 1) / 2 + (a - b + 1) * (a - b) / 2) % MOD;
                fdp[a] = (fdp[a] + fdp[b - 1] * fdp[a - b] % MOD * (a + 1) % MOD * combi[a - 1][b - 1]) % MOD;
                gdp[a] = (gdp[a] + ((gdp[b - 1] * fdp[a - b] + fdp[b - 1] * gdp[a - b]) % MOD * (a + 1) + fdp[b - 1] * fdp[a - b] % MOD * total) % MOD * combi[a - 1][b - 1]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (a = 0; a < Math.min(M, N - M + 1); a++) {
            for (b = 0; b <= M; b++) {
                for (c = 1; c <= M - b; c++) {
                    temp = fdp[c] * combi[b + c][b] % MOD;
                    hdp[a + 1][b + c][0] = (hdp[a + 1][b + c][0] + hdp[a][b][0] * temp) % MOD;
                    hdp[a + 1][b + c][1] = (hdp[a + 1][b + c][1] + hdp[a][b][1] * temp) % MOD;
                    hdp[a + 1][b + c][1] = (hdp[a + 1][b + c][1] + hdp[a][b][0] * gdp[c] % MOD * combi[b + c][b]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        res = 0;
        int limit2 = Math.min(M, N - M + 1);
        for (a = 1; a <= limit2; a++) {
            res = (res + hdp[a][M][1] * combi[N - M + 1][a]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(res % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
